title: History and Geography Keyword Quiz
subtitle: 30 Grade 5 multiple-choice questions
introText: Practice history, geography, government, and ancient Asia vocabulary from your textbook pages. Choose an answer, get instant feedback, and see your score at the end.

questions.question: Which word means a written record of what people have done in the past?

What do we call a scientist who studies the past through excavations and artifacts?

A diary written by someone who witnessed an event is what kind of source?
A writer uses an eyewitness’s diary to retell an event. What kind of source is the writer’s account?
